title: Mamba2 ladder hard-coded head_dim from d_model/n_heads — wrong with FLA defaults
root_cause: The ladder configurators forced fla_layer_kwargs={'head_dim': ensure_multiple_of(d_model/n_heads, 128)}. FLA's Mamba2 already derives head_dim from its own internal layout, so injecting an externally-rounded value made the constructed Mamba2 layer disagree with the configured d_model/n_heads, producing a model whose effective head dimension differed from what other code assumed.
invariant: When using a third-party layer factory (FLA Mamba2), head_dim must be derived by that library, not externally rounded and re-injected.
diff_summary: Comment out the head_dim override in fla_layer_kwargs in both pure and hybrid mamba ladder scripts.
silent_check: FLA constructs the Mamba2 layer with whatever head_dim was passed and trains; the only effect is a silent mismatch between the configured and effective head dimension that produces a finite but unintended forward pass.
